title: Gate answers
description: Written only by the cockpit, once per gate. Exactly one of marks, choice, choices, none or decision.

marks.description: mark-list: one mark per item name.

choices.description: concept-pick: combine these options in the next round.

none.description: concept-pick: none of these; the note says what was missing.

notes.description: mark-list only: optional notes from the user, by row name. Applying copies each into the note of the log entry its row creates.

log.description: Stamped by the server from the gate request: this gate decided guardrails.

texts.description: Stamped by the server: each row's text exactly as the user saw it.

permit.description: Stamped by the server from an approve gate's permit, exactly as the user saw it.

target.description: The protected file the user approved a change to.

change.description: The one-sentence change, as the user saw it.

targets.description: Stamped by the server on review answers: the files each row's mark may change, exactly as the user saw them.
